name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea fired several missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth launch in a month; no later launch found to 11 Nov
state: South Korea said North Korea fired multiple missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth weapons launch in a month (The Star), and North Korea said on 5 Nov it had tested a new air defence system and a long-range cruise missile (Korea Herald; NBC News). Searches on 11 Nov found no later launch, nuclear test, ICBM overflight of Japan or clash. A launch within the last two weeks keeps Watch.
for_you: Launches seldom affect daily life in South Korea or Japan, but they can trigger local alerts. Travellers can follow FCDO travel advice for South Korea and Japan.
rubric_hit: Ballistic or cruise missile launches within two weeks (4 Nov) = Watch; no nuclear test or ICBM overflight

why: North Korea is a nuclear state with ICBMs; tension here involves the US, China, Japan and Russia simultaneously.
drivers: Missile tests, Russia–DPRK military cooperation, US–ROK exercises, border incidents.

rubric.alert: Nuclear test, ICBM overflight of Japan, or military clash.
rubric.watch: Ballistic or cruise missile launches, or troop deployments abroad.
rubric.normal: No missile launches in two weeks; no border incidents.
